summary.text: Stephen "Steve" Woll is an independent candidate for Virginia's 3rd District. According to his campaign website, he is a Navy veteran, scientist, and businessman who grew up in Pittsburgh and has lived in Hampton Roads for more than 25 years. He says he is running as a representative who answers to the district rather than to a party.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, grew up in Pittsburgh and lived in several places before the Navy brought him to Hampton Roads more than 25 years ago.

Says he attended Officer Candidate School and served 21 years in the Navy as a Meteorology and Oceanography Officer, including aboard the USS Harry S. Truman on September 11, a deployment supporting Operation Iraqi Freedom, and a final assignment commanding support operations for a dozen aircraft carriers and large-deck amphibious ships across the Atlantic Fleet.

After leaving the Navy, says he worked in the private sector helping companies and clients use data, technology, and teamwork on operational problems, including public-private partnerships in Hampton Roads, and has for several years worked with a veteran-inspired service organization focused on civic divides.
